partially_answered: The self-preference question, in its exact form ('is content optimised with one model disproportionately recommended by that same model?'): no published study tests this. Reported as unanswered in the report body, as the charter permits. The adjacent and commercially stronger finding IS answered and cited: LLMs prefer LLM-authored over human-authored options when recommending (PNAS [31][32]); same-model self-preference is documented for judging [34] and for brand/company association [33], but not for content recommendation.
